name: upnext
description: Minimalist always-on-top task manager — Tauri desktop + Firebase PWA
author: Abhishek Ingle

scripts.release:patch: node increment-version.cjs patch && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: bump patch version" && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: node increment-version.cjs minor && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: bump minor version" && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: node increment-version.cjs major && git add -A && git commit -m "chore: bump major version" && git push origin main --tags
